tools.name: detect_ioc
tools.description: Auto-detect the type of an indicator of compromise (IOC) and return relevant threat intelligence. Supports: IPv4, IPv6, CIDR ranges, domains, URLs, file hashes (MD5/SHA1/SHA256/SHA512), email addresses, MAC addresses.

value.description: The IOC to analyze (IP, domain, hash, URL, email, MAC...)

tools.name: scan_ip
tools.description: Look up an IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) or a CIDR range: geolocation, ISP, ASN, datacenter/proxy/VPN flags, TOR consensus status, reverse DNS with forward confirmation, and the RDAP allocation record including the abuse contact.

ip.description: The IP address to look up (IPv4 or IPv6), or a CIDR range

tools.name: scan_hash
tools.description: Look up a file hash (MD5, SHA1 or SHA256) across several reputation feeds at once: CIRCL hashlookup, MalwareBazaar, ThreatFox, MalShare, OTX. Check sources_answered before treating a miss as meaningful.

hash.description: A file hash as a hex digest: MD5 (32), SHA1 (40) or SHA256 (64)

tools.name: scan_url
tools.description: Analyze a URL: scheme, host confusion, credentials-in-URL, dangerous extensions, shorteners, embedded redirects, and what a previous mlab domain scan recorded about the host. Set resolve=true only to unmask a shortener.

resolve.description: Follow redirects to the real destination

tools.name: scan_email
tools.description: Analyze an email address: mailbox type (disposable/role/consumer), the domain's mail spoofability verdict (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), MX presence, and an aggregate 0-100 score with weighted reasons.

tools.name: scan_phone
tools.description: Analyze a phone number (E.164 form): validity, country/region, line type, allocated operator, formatting, and scam-shape findings. Offline lookup.

number.description: Phone number, ideally in E.164 form with a leading '+'

tools.name: smishing_risk
tools.description: Score an SMS / text message for smishing (SMS phishing). Returns a 0-100 risk score, a band (clean/suspect/high/critical), a recommended filter action, the weighted reasons behind the score, and the IOCs extracted from the message.

text.description: The SMS / message body to score

country.description: Country code selecting the keyword/brand pack (e.g. 'fr'). Defaults to 'fr'.

tools.name: get_scan_limits
tools.description: Returns the remaining scan quotas for your organization (IP, domain, file, and crypto scans). Limits are per-day and shared across all organization members.
